results.snippet: Rasuwagadhi, located about 152 kilometers north of Kathmandu, is one of the key trade routes between Nepal and China. According to customs data, electric vehicles account for 60% of imports through this crossing. Electrical equipment, clothing, footwear, agricultural goods, telecommunications equipment, machinery for hydropower projects, cars, and industrial equipment are also imported through it.
